args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions following the v2.3.1 deployment (error rate ~18% in us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Remediation: rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release with a healthy production track record, in all regions. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east), leaving a mixed-version state; a retry completed the rollout to v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Post-rollback service health is confirmed: healthy, error rate down to ~0.2%. Follow-up: root-cause the v2.3.1 failure and investigate the orchestrator error that caused the initial partial rollback before re-attempting a v2.3.1 release.

The incident was actually created successfully despite the timeout — **INC-0001** is open with the full details, so the on-call has been paged. No duplicate needed.

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api failed health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18% across us-east, us-west, and eu-west).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** (the most recent version with a healthy production track record — v2.3.1 was unhealthy, v2.3.0 and v2.2.9 were healthy). The first rollback attempt partially failed due to an orchestrator error (halted after us-east, leaving a mixed-version state), so I retried and completed the rollback in all three regions.
2. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy in us-east, us-west, and eu-west on v2.3.0, with error rate down from 18% to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failure, the rollback (including the partial-failure retry), and follow-ups: root-cause v2.3.1 and investigate the orchestrator error that caused the initial partial rollback before re-attempting a v2.3.1 release.
